# VX SDK (vx3) - LLM Documentation Index

This file is an index of documents under `docs/llm` intended to be easily referenced by LLMs and document search agents.
Paths are relative to the `docs` directory.

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nk4dev/vx/refs/heads/dev/docs/llm/overview.md:
  - Project overview, purpose, and core features
  - Developer information (Maintainer: @nk4dev)
  - License (MIT)
  - Programming languages (TypeScript, JavaScript, Solidity)
  - Feature summary (multi-chain support, wallet management, local development server, Hardhat integration, gas monitoring, RPC management)

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nk4dev/vx/refs/heads/dev/docs/llm/installation.md:
  - Installation requirements (Node.js 18+, npm/pnpm/yarn; Bun optional)
  - Global installation steps (`npm install -g @nk4dev/vx`)
  - Local project installation (`npm install @nk4dev/vx`)
  - Build-from-source steps (`git clone`, `npm install`, `npm run build`)
  - One-off usage with `npx` and Bun build examples

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nk4dev/vx/refs/heads/dev/docs/llm/commands.md:
  - CLI command list and descriptions
  - Detailed usage (options and environment variables)
  - Key commands:
    - `vx3 create` (scaffold a new project)
    - `vx3 rpc init` (initialize RPC configuration)
    - `vx3 serve` (start the development server; `--debug` option)
    - `vx3 gas` (retrieve gas information)
    - `vx3 setup hardhat` (scaffold Hardhat files)
    - `vx3 pay` (send payments/transactions)
  - Examples (PowerShell / bash) and recommended best practices

- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nk4dev/vx/refs/heads/dev/docs/llm/usage.md:
  - How to integrate the SDK with code examples
  - TypeScript / ESM and CommonJS import examples
  - Payment module usage for sending transactions programmatically
  - Component generation commands (React / Vue)
  - React component examples and Next.js dynamic routing examples
  - Hooks usage examples (`usePayment`, `usePaymentStatus`, `usePaymentDialog`)

Search keywords (guidance for LLMs):
- vx3, vx3 create, vx3 rpc init, vx3 serve --debug, vx3 pay, vx3 gas
- Payment, ethers.js, Hardhat, Wallet, RPC configuration
- TypeScript, JavaScript, Solidity, React, Vue

Notes:
- Refer to each entry and extract detailed content from the corresponding document sections.
- When parsing, open `docs/llm/<file>.md` and prioritize sections such as "Overview", "Examples", and "CLI" for each file.
